name: muslim
description: A Claude Code mod for Muslim developers.

thikr.title: Thikr line
thikr.description: Show tasabih in place of Claude's working words

thikrSpeed.title: Thikr speed
thikrSpeed.description: auto (1s + 0.5s per word), or whole seconds per phrase from 1 to 60

thikrEnd.title: Thikr end-of-turn line
thikrEnd.description: Show تَمَّ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ when a turn ends

thikrMode.title: Thikr mode
thikrMode.description: all: every group in turn; salawat: one salawat on the Prophet ﷺ for each whole turn

athkar.title: Athkar
athkar.description: Morning and evening athkar above the prompt, to read and count

athkarStyle.title: Athkar style
athkarStyle.description: sky: a sky that follows the time of day; outline: plain

athkarColor.title: Athkar color
athkarColor.description: The main color of the athkar
